provenance: Original synthetic lyrics written for this experiment, not published song lyrics. Expectations are reviewer-only and never included in prompts.

cases.text: My sister left a blue jar beside the gate.
cases.expectation: Sister (female sibling), left/placed a blue jar, beside gate; do not turn left into kept.
cases.next: She did not break it; I did.

cases.text: She did not break it; I did.
cases.expectation: She=sister, it=jar from previous line; sister did NOT break it, speaker DID. Pronoun omission acceptable if roles/polarity preserved.
cases.previous: My sister left a blue jar beside the gate.

cases.text: I never said you were the one who left.
cases.expectation: Speaker denies having said YOU were the departing person. Do not assert nobody left or speaker left.
cases.previous: She did not break it; I did.
